<style id="cl-gta-bg">

.hero-pin,.drive-pin,.gallery,.community,.about{isolation:isolate}
.hero-pin::before,.drive-pin::before,.gallery::before,.community::before,.about::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
  background-position:center;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat}
.hero-pin::after,.drive-pin::after,.gallery::after,.community::after,.about::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(2,6,10,.38),rgba(2,6,10,.62))}
.hero-pin::before{background-image:url("assets/gpt-bg1.webp")}
.drive-pin::before{background-image:url("assets/gpt-bg2.webp")}
.gallery::before{background-image:url("assets/gpt-bg3.webp")}
.community::before,.about::before{background-image:url("assets/gpt-bg4.webp")}
.portal,.speedlines,.drive-tunnel,.drive-ring,.speed-zip{opacity:.16!important}
